Name: Nicholas Galitzine NPC (Big WIP)

Description:
Adds Nicholas Galitzine as a marriage candidate in Stardew Valley!


[color=#9900ff][b]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. [/b][/color]
[size=1]Will eventually have other requirements, but that is it for now.[/size]
